description.value: Bluebird Cafe is a scratch-bakery café in Golden, BC, situated on the road to Moonraker Mountain Bike Trails, Kicking Horse Resort, and other nearby adventures. The kitchen bakes muffins and desserts fresh daily, serves organic Caffe Monte coffee, and offers made-from-scratch breakfasts and lunches. Cyclists will find purpose-built bagged trail lunches, broad vegetarian and vegan menu options, and an environmentally conscious take-away setup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is active and substantive, confirming an operating café in Golden, BC on the route to Moonraker Mountain Bike Trails. Takeout is confirmed by explicit mention of biodegradable take-away packaging; a dedicated 'Bagged Lunch' menu item including trail mix confirms packed lunches for cyclists. Vegetarian, vegan (Vegan Tomato Relish, Veggie Falafel Wrap), and gluten-free (GF Bread listed) options are all evidenced in the menu. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and Wi-Fi (despite OSM internet_access=wlan) are not mentioned anywhere on the website, so those remain null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established café in Golden directly on the way to Moonraker Mountain Bike Trails, offering purpose-built bagged lunches, vegetarian/vegan/GF options, and eco-conscious takeout — a strong fit for touring cyclists.
